success_metrics.description: one metric per goal, each checkable by reading the page

out_of_scope.description: items left out of the page: teacher names, phone number, embedded map and online payment

online_payment_exclusion.description: states that no online payment is taken and that payment is made at the studio

goal.description: the goal id this metric measures, e.g. "G1"

metric.description: what is checked by reading the page

target.description: the state to reach, with no invented numbers

window.description: the measurement window; write "measurement window not set" when the brief doesn't say
